extracted.intended_audience: researchers and grant applicants based at UK research organisations seeking EPSRC/UKRI funding
extracted.subtask_description: Listing of current EPSRC funding opportunities including basic eligibility notes, award ranges, funder/co-funder information, and opening/closing dates. Useful for prospective applicants preparing to apply to EPSRC/UKRI grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant eligibility — UK research organisation
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for EPSRC funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated under the 'Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills' opportunity; implies host organisation eligibility is a precondition for application. No further eligibility detail provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to the 'UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment (invite only)' call; only invited applicants may submit an application to this opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award range — Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the expected total award available for successful applicants to establish a UK centre for quantum commercialisation skills. Associated metadata on this page: funding type = Grant, opening date = 6 May 2026 9:00am UK time, closing date = 7 July 2026 4:00pm UK time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding amount and FEC — UKRI metascience call
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the expected funding level and the funding model (80% FEC) for the invite-only metascience call. The page also lists the total fund (£3,000,000) and the co-funders and funders involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity status
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the listed calls are currently accepting applications. Each opportunity has its own status and should be checked individually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding type
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the form of funding available for the listed opportunities (grant awards).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication, opening and closing dates/times
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication date, opening date and closing date (with times, UK time) are provided for each opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must note and comply with the specific opening and closing datetimes provided (e.g., Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills: publication 7 May 2026; opening 6 May 2026 9:00am UK time; closing 7 July 2026 4:00pm UK time).
